reviews.comment: Be prepared to read and write a lot. You'll read poems, short stories, and a novella. With this, you'll do many assignments with 2 essays being the bulk of the grade. Give yourself time to think and write. The assignments are time consuming. She provides helpful feedback, but only after final submissions. There are no drafts for review.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: A simple class. Prof is very nice. Attendance is mandatory.

Dr. Barron is very professional, so don't expect a super personal relationship with her. However, she is very nice and understanding. Her lectures are pretty boring, and she grades a little more harshly than needed for a 100 class. Overall, pretty easy class and not difficult to get an A. Lots of busywork and many large projects though.

For Engl 376 - She is a nice lady, and her class is not too hard. But the lectures are so boring, and she mostly just tells you to talk to the person next to you the whole time and discuss the assigned reading. This makes it hard to be motivated to go to class. Not a tough grader per se, but sometimes seems arbitrary and she is so slow grading.

ENGL 376- Super sweet and understanding. Great to conversate with. As long as you follow instructions you will do great. Good amount of reading but not too many assignments. Classes are boring in my opinion and it is important to go as much as you can, but she is understanding when you need to miss. would definitely recommend this class!

**for ENGL 376- loved her so much. She's so sweet, caring, she is very chill and straight up with students which I love. Her assignments aren't hard as long as you follow the instructions. Plenty assignments but homework wasn't much at all. She's very understanding. Highly highly recommend

**This is for ENGL 210**
Good amount of work each week but that's just the nature of the class. Quick grader and usually gave good feedback. Had some issues with our project that she was very understanding about and provided accommodations.

reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Really sweet, really caring professor. Assignments are not bad, however, the work does get a little overwhelming towards the end but it is manageable. Lectures do get a tad boring but that's the only complaint. Overall definitely take her.

Dr. Barron was super nice. Her lectures were not needed most of the time I did my work in class. She gives a really good amount of time to do all the essays. overall she was a good professor, but I wouldnt have gone to class as much as I did knwoing that her lectures were pretty boring and pointless.
Dr. Barron's lectures are boring and pointless at times, but as long as you pay attention and put forth effort she will work with you to ensure you get a good grade.

She is an amazing professor. She was very caring and moved due dates based on class feedback. The class itself has 3 major papers, but it isn't too difficult. If you turn work in on time and put in a decent amount of effort you will have an A. If you need to take English 104, take Dr.Barron.

I LOVE DR. BARRON. If you have to take English 104, TAKE HER! She is so caring of what may be going on in your life and is such a kind person. She follows the rubric, and a majority of the assignments are easy As, except the essays. DO NOT procrastinate on the essays. The end of the year gets tough as far as workload goes, but she is amazing!
